request.text: When the trip's over, close the Pot. Everyone gets their fair share back.
request.previous_text: Bigger spends go to the group. The three-hundred-dollar boat trip needs two of three… so Leo approves, right from a notification.
request.next_text: Under the hood, every Pot is a Sputnik D-A-O on Near. Its rules are enforced on-chain, not by a person. Every action is gasless. And no one can take money out alone.
